rows.claim: A search of the whole filesystem found no calibration file.
rows.evidence: In T0B4 the agent ran `find / -name "calibration*" 2>/dev/null | head`. The tool result (T0B5) showed no find output before the pandas traceback, so no file matched. The `2>/dev/null` hid permission errors, but the search did cover the whole filesystem. The `ls -R inputs` in T0B3 also showed only readings.csv in inputs.
